neighbours.label: the period closing an encyclopedia-style defining first sentence ('X was a naval battle of the ... War.') when the article continues
fire: The Siege of Malta was a military campaign of the Ottoman-Habsburg wars. It lasted from May to September 1565 and ended in an Ottoman retreat.
The Treaty of Westphalia was a set of peace agreements signed in the Holy Roman Empire. It brought the Thirty Years' War to a close.
The Battle of Jutland was a naval battle of the First World War. Fought in 1916 off the coast of Denmark, it involved some 250 ships.
The Lisbon earthquake was a natural disaster that struck the Kingdom of Portugal. It destroyed much of the capital on the morning of 1 November 1755.
Hadrian's Wall was a defensive fortification in the Roman province of Britannia. Construction began in AD 122 under the emperor Hadrian.
The Great Stink was an event in central London during the hot summer of 1858. It led Parliament to fund a new sewer network for the city.
The Battle of Hastings was a battle of the Norman conquest of England. It was fought on 14 October 1066 near the town of Battle.
The Hanseatic League was a commercial confederation of merchant guilds in northern Europe. At its height it controlled trade across the Baltic Sea.
